body: I stand up slowly, my heart racing with curiosity, and take a tentative step forward. The ribbon-clad box seems out of place among the lush green rows of vegetables and the earthy smell of the soil. As I draw closer, I notice the intricate patterns woven into the ribbons, and my mind begins to wander about what kind of gift could have been inside.
